blocks.title: Dative bond
blocks.text: Dative bond do atoms ke darmiyan tab banta hai jab share hone wala electron pair sirf ek hi atom deta hai (donate karta hai).

H₂O aur proton (H⁺) ke darmiyan bond banne ki misal lein. H₂O mein do covalent bonds hain aur oxygen atom par electrons ke do lone pairs (akele jore) hain. Doosri taraf proton ke paas koi electron nahi. Is liye oxygen atom apna ek lone pair H⁺ ko de deta hai, jo use le leta hai (acceptor), aur yun dative bond ban jata hai, jaise neeche diagram mein hai (Figure 3.3(a)).

Carbon monoxide mein bhi oxygen aur carbon ke darmiyan dative bond hai. Oxygen apne do valence electrons carbon ke saath share kar ke aam double covalent bond banati hai. Lekin in bonds se carbon ki valency poori nahi hoti; octet poora karne ke liye use ek aur electron pair chahiye. Oxygen apna ek lone pair de kar ek aur covalent bond banati hai, aur yehi dative bond hai (Figure 3.3(b)).

blocks.alt: Dative bond banne ki teen misalein. (a) Pani aur H+; neela muRa teer oxygen ka lone pair H+ ko deta hai, aur hasil mein O se naye H ki taraf laal teer. (b) CO: 'Lewis structure' teen sanjhe joron ke saath, aur bond wali shakal: do lakeerein aur O se C ki taraf laal teer. (c) O=O jama oxygen free radical ('oxygen free radical' likha); neela muRa teer lone pair dena dikhata hai, aur ozone banti hai jis mein darmiyan O+ aur teer O- ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.3: Dative bond banna (a) oxonium (hydronium) ion, (b) carbon monoxide, (c) ozone molecule (kitab ki Figure 3.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; chhapa caption (b) aur (c) ulat deta hai).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Laal electrons woh hain jo dene wala (donor) atom deta hai. (a) mein O apna ek lone pair H⁺ ko deta hai. (b) mein O ke chhe electrons mein se do us ke apne paas rehte hain aur chaar C ke saath share hote hain: in mein ek pair O ka apna diya hua (dative) pair hai, is liye teer O se C ki taraf hai. (c) mein O₂ ki ek oxygen apna lone pair free radical oxygen ko deti hai; dene wali O par + aur lene wali O par − charge aa jata hai. Kitab ki caption mein (b) ozone aur (c) carbon monoxide likha hai, lekin figure aur text mein (b) CO aur (c) ozone hai; yahan sahi tarteeb di gayi hai.

Ozone molecule ki structure Figure 3.3(c) mein hai. Yeh oxygen molecule aur ek oxygen atom (free radical, O) ke reaction se banti hai. Molecule ka ek oxygen atom is free radical ko apna electron pair de kar coordinate covalent bond banata hai. Is tarah beech wale atom ke kul teen bonds hain: ek taraf double covalent bond aur doosri taraf coordinate covalent bond. Beech wale atom par positive charge hai, aur jo oxygen atom lone pair leta hai us par negative charge.

blocks.prompt: a) N₂ aur CS₂ molecules ki Lewis structures banayein.
blocks.explanation: N₂: :N≡N: — dono nitrogen atoms teen pairs share karte hain (triple bond) aur har nitrogen par ek lone pair hai; har atom ka octet poora. CS₂: S=C=S — carbon har sulfur ke saath do pairs share karta hai (do double bonds) aur har sulfur par do lone pairs hain.

answer_figure.alt: Do rows: N₂ mein dono N ke darmiyan teen shared pairs (laal dots) aur har N par ek lone pair, phir line form N≡N. CS₂ mein C aur har S ke darmiyan do shared pairs, har S par do lone pairs, phir line form S=C=S.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram: n₂ aur CS₂ ki Lewis structures (electron-dot aur line form)
answer_figure.long_description: Baayen electron-dot form hai jis mein shared pairs laal dots hain; teer ke baad wahi structure lines se. N₂: teen shared pairs yani triple bond, har N par ek lone pair, dono ka octet poora. CS₂: carbon har sulfur ke saath do pairs share karta hai (do double bonds), har S par do lone pairs.

blocks.prompt: b) BF₃ mein B ke valence shell mein kitne electrons hain? Kya woh lone pair le sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Boron ke teen B–F bonds hain, yani sirf chhe (6) electrons; octet mein do kam hain aur ek orbital khali hai. Is liye haan, B kisi aur atom ka lone pair le sakta hai (acceptor ban sakta hai).

blocks.prompt: c) NH₃ aur BF₃ ke darmiyan dative bond ka banna dikhayein.
blocks.explanation: NH₃ ki nitrogen par ek lone pair hai; BF₃ ke boron ka ek orbital khali hai. Nitrogen apna lone pair boron ke khali orbital mein de deti hai: H₃N→BF₃. Nitrogen donor hai, boron acceptor, aur ab dono ka octet poora hai.

items: Dative (coordinate covalent) bond: share hone wale dono electrons ek hi atom deta hai. H₃O⁺ (O ka lone pair H⁺ ko), CO (O ka lone pair C ko), O₃ (O₂ ki ek O free radical oxygen ko deti hai; beech wali O par +, lene wali O par −).
